informes.tpl.corrida.desc: What happened in a run: species, events, genetics and the six metric groups.
informes.tpl.comparacion.desc: Two runs overlaid, with their configuration differences and their final values.
informes.tpl.replicas.desc: Mean, p10–p90 band and a table of means and deviations from a replicates job.

informes.vistaVacia: Pick a template and generate the report to see it here.
